reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, AVG(net_revenue_eur) AS avg_line_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
HAVING AVG(net_revenue_eur) > 200
alternatives: SELECT store_code, AVG(net_revenue_eur) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING 200 < AVG(net_revenue_eur)

SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur) > 200

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur) > 200
other_way.tradeoff: Builds the average from a sum and a count, which shows the idea, but AVG is shorter.
